_about: Crossbow shot. Kimodo: phases (one sentence each); prop_in_hands: grip, aim, recoil. Times in s.
_reference: Stance (crossbow manuals): left hand UNDER the stock, palm up, fingers below the bolt track, pressing the crossbow into the shoulder; butt in the shoulder pocket, cheek on the stock; right elbow close to the body; left elbow down, weight on the bone.

phases.text: A person stands relaxed, holding a crossbow low in front of the hips with both hands.
The person lifts the crossbow up to the right shoulder with both hands and aims straight ahead.
The person fires the crossbow, the weapon kicks up and the upper body jolts backward from the recoil.
The person brings the crossbow back down to the hips and stands upright, holding it low with both hands.

hands._: only for kimodo_motion.py --template (hand constraints). Kimodo frame (Y up, Z forward, human metres ~1.75 m). Not used by default: hurts hunched characters

grip._: prop frame: X along the stock forward, Y to the character's LEFT, Z up. Words: palm = side of the prop the hand is on, fingers = where they point

hold._: outside aiming: both hands in front of the body, grips centred above the hips, in front of the belly

key_poses._: frames at 24 fps, reviewed before generation; the clip ends in the first pose
